news.analysis: Daniels wasn't his sharpest, throwing his first two interceptions of the season, but he got the job done. He threw two long touchdowns in the game, including a game-winning 32-yard TD toss to Stefon Diggs with 57 seconds left in regulation. Daniels now has 1,499 passing yards, 10 touchdowns, and two interceptions through seven games this year. He will be a solid QB1 in fantasy in Week 11 vs. the Bengals.
news.contents: Jayden Daniels completed 23 of his 33 passes for 249 yards, three touchdowns, and two interceptions while adding 28 rushing yards on 11 carries in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10's Thursday night game.

news.analysis: McCarthy dealt with a hip pointer throughout the week, but it didn't seem to be an issue for him in the loss on Thursday night. The veteran signal-caller found Isaiah Likely for a 66-yard touchdown catch in the fourth quarter to give the Giants a temporary lead. McCarthy has thrown for 915 yards, two touchdowns, and two interceptions in five games for the Giants this year. He will be a solid QB2 in a tough matchup against the Jaguars in Week 11.
news.contents: J.J. McCarthy completed 23 of his 36 passes for 293 yards, one touchdown, and one interception while adding 34 rushing yards on six carries in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10's Thursday night game.

news.analysis: Okonkwo finished second on the team in targets despite missing some time during the game with a back issue. He was able to return to the game after getting the injury checked out, but fellow tight end Ben Sinnott caught a touchdown pass during his absence. Okonkwo now has 27 catches for 263 yards through seven contests. He will look for his first TD of the season in Week 11 vs. the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.contents: Chig Okonkwo caught four of his eight targets for 24 yards in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10's Thursday night game.
news.title: Chig Okonkwo catches four passes in TNF win

news.contents: Washington Commanders tight end Chig Okonkwo (back) has returned to Thursday's Week 10 contest against the New York Giants. Okonkwo was forced to exit to the locker room in the second quarter with a back issue. Before leaving, Okonkwo hauled in both of his targets for 17 yards. He missed the rest of the second quarter, but Okonkwo is back for the second half of this game. The return of Okonkwo should mean that Ben Sinnott goes back to having a minimal role.
news.title: Chig Okonkwo Returns to Thursday's Game
